review_candidates.title: Engines Foreman
review_candidates.description: Job Type Full-time Description Engines Foreman Location: Orange Beach, AL / Gulf Coast Region Job Type: Full-Time Position Type: Field Service Pay: $45.00–$60.00 per hour, based on experience Bonus: Eligible for an annual performance bonus Reports To: Branch Manager Direct Reports: Yes About The Role MSHS Pacific Power Group is looking for an experienced Engines Foreman to lead our field service technicians in the inspection, maintenance, overhaul, and repair of industrial engines and power generation systems. This is a field service leadership position with variable travel requirements . The role will have a strong focus on the Orange Beach, Alabama area , with additional coverage across Gulf Shores, Mobile, Pascagoula, and surrounding Gulf Coast marine markets . As the Engines Foreman, you will serve as the primary technical leader for engine-related work and will have direct reports , providing hands-on leadership, advanced troubleshooting expertise, and mentorship to our engine technicians. You will also coordinate labor, materials, equipment, and schedules to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with manufacturer standards, company procedures, and regulatory requirements. You’ll work closely with Operations, Service, Project Management, and Parts teams to support major engine overhauls, repairs, installations, outages, and emergency service calls while helping develop and mentor the next generation of engine technicians. Join a high-performance team where technical expertise, quality workmanship, and results matter. What You'll Do Engine Maintenance & Overhaul Lead and perform advanced diagnostics, repair, and overhaul of diesel, natural gas, and propane engines. Oversee engine tear-downs, rebuilds, inspections, and component replacements, including fuel, cooling, lubrication, emissions, and turbocharger systems. Ensure all work meets OEM specifications, technical manuals, service bulletins, and company procedures. Verify proper commissioning, testing, and engine performance following repairs or installations. Field Service & Team Leadership Directly supervise and provide hands-on leadership to field service technicians. Plan and assign job tasks, ensuring efficient use of technicians, tools, equipment, and materials. Monitor job progress and ensure service work, outages, and rebuild projects are completed safely and on schedule. Provide technical support during emergency service calls and rapid-response troubleshooting situations. Travel to customer sites throughout the Gulf Coast region based on business and customer needs. Adjust travel and work schedules to support changing service requirements, outages, and emergency calls. Project & Job Coordination Coordinate manpower, parts, tooling, and equipment for engine rebuilds and major service projects. Partner with Project Managers on large engine overhauls, upgrades, and installations. Monitor labor hours, job costs, and productivity to support operational and financial performance. Assist with estimating labor and material requirements for service quotes and aftermarket work. Technical Leadership & Training Provide hands-on technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to engine technicians. Train technicians on diagnostics, rebuild procedures, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices. Serve as a subject matter expert for engine systems and complex troubleshooting situations. Keep technicians informed of OEM updates, service bulletins, technologies, and changes in repair procedures. Safety, Quality & Compliance Lead by example and enforce company safety policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental, NFPA, EPA, and applicable regulatory requirements. Perform quality checks to ensure engine repairs and rebuilds meet reliability and performance expectations. Maintain accurate service documentation, inspection reports, work orders, and rebuild records. Customer & Business Support Serve as a technical point of contact for customers during engine service and overhaul projects. Communicate job status, technical findings, and recommendations clearly and professionally. Identify opportunities for additional service, upgrades, and preventative maintenance. Build strong customer relationships through technical expertise, responsiveness, and professionalism. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to improve service processes, efficiency, quality, and turnaround times. Support standardization of engine rebuild procedures and documentation. Provide feedback regarding tooling, parts inventory, equipment, and operational needs. Assist with workforce planning, scheduling, and allocation of field resources. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. 7–10+ years of experience working with industrial engines, power generation equipment, heavy machinery, or a related field. Proven experience performing engine diagnostics, rebuilds, major repairs, and component replacement. Advanced knowledge of diesel, natural gas, and propane engine systems. Strong understanding of fuel, cooling, lubrication, emissions, and related engine systems. Ability to read and interpret engine schematics, service manuals, technical documentation, and OEM specifications. Experience using diagnostic tools, engine control systems, and performance testing equipment. Ability to work with work order systems, service reporting tools, and time-tracking systems. Strong mechanical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work safely in field and industrial environments. Ability and willingness to travel as required to support customer and business needs. Preferred Qualifications Technical/trade school education or an associate degree in Diesel Technology, Power Generation, Industrial Maintenance, or a related field. Prior leadership, lead technician, or supervisory experience in a service environment. Experience directly supervising and developing technicians. Experience with industrial power generation equipment and major engine overhaul projects. Familiarity with NFPA, EPA, OSHA, and applicable environmental and safety regulations. What Will Make You Successful We're looking for someone who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills . The ideal candidate is an experienced engine technician who enjoys solving complex problems, takes pride in quality workmanship, and can confidently lead technicians through challenging repairs and projects. You'll Be Successful In This Role If You Are A strong technical problem-solver who can diagnose complex engine issues. A hands-on leader who enjoys developing and mentoring technicians. Comfortable providing direction and accountability to direct reports. Organized and able to manage multiple jobs and priorities simultaneously. A clear communicator with technicians, customers, Project Managers, and leadership. Detail-oriented and committed to quality and safety. Comfortable making decisions in high-pressure service and outage environments. Adaptable to changing field service schedules and travel requirements. Accountable, dependable, and willing to step in when the team needs support. Physical & Work Requirements Ability to work in field service environments, including industrial facilities, marine environments, and outdoor conditions. Ability to lift and move engine components, tools, and equipment weighing 50+ pounds. Frequent standing, bending, climbing, kneeling, and working in confined spaces. Ability to travel to customer job sites throughout the Gulf Coast region, including overnight travel as needed. Ability to work extended hours, weekends, and emergency call-outs when required. Ability to work safely and effectively in varying weather and job-site conditions. Compensation & Benefits $45.00–$60.00 per hour, based on experience. Eligible for an annual performance bonus. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. Health Savings Account (HSA) and/or Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options. Company-paid and voluntary life insurance options. Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability coverage. 401(k) retirement plan with company matching. Paid time off and company-paid holidays. Employee assistance and wellness resources. Opportunities for professional development and technical training. Benefits are subject to plan eligibility, applicable waiting periods, and the terms and conditions of the applicable benefit plans. Why This Role Matters The Engines Foreman plays a critical role in keeping our customers' power generation and industrial engine systems operating safely and reliably. Your technical expertise and leadership will directly impact equipment uptime, service quality, customer satisfaction, and the development of our technician team. Equal Opportunity Employer MSHS PPG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Drug-Free Workplace MSHS PPG is a Drug-Free Workplace. All offers of employment are contingent on successful completion of a drug and alcohol screening, which may include testing for marijuana in compliance with applicable federal regulations and relevant state labor laws. We understand that marijuana laws vary by state, and our testing policies are designed to ensure compliance with both federal and state requirements where applicable. review_candidates.title: East Africa Photographer, Reuters
review_candidates.description: Job Description Reuters Pictures is looking for a Photographer based in Nairobi, Kenya, to join our East Africa team. The role is part of our One Newsroom approach, where text, pictures and video teams work closely together to deliver fast, accurate and impactful journalism for global audiences. The successful candidate will be responsible for producing high-quality news, business and sports photography, while also working closely with colleagues across formats to support Reuters' visual and editorial coverage. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of covering major stories and producing compelling visual journalism. They should be able to spot news, work independently in the field, and contribute original visual story ideas that help Reuters stand out. A good understanding of the political, economic and social landscape of Kenya and the wider East Africa region is essential. The successful candidate should also be well connected, have strong sourcing skills, and be able to identify opportunities for distinctive and original photography. The role requires someone who can work confidently in difficult and fast-moving situations, including protests, elections, humanitarian crises and conflict environments. Experience working in hostile environments will be an advantage. Key Responsibilities Working closely with colleagues across text, video and pictures, the successful candidate will: Generate and develop visual story ideas. Plan and execute coverage of breaking news, enterprise, business, sports and other major events. Produce compelling, accurate and visually strong photography that meets Reuters' editorial and technical standards. Work closely with text and video colleagues to identify opportunities for integrated coverage and distinctive visual storytelling. Contribute to Reuters' One Newsroom ambitions through strong collaboration across formats. Produce content that works for Reuters' global clients and digital audiences. Identify opportunities for exclusive pictures, deeper visual storytelling and longer-term photographic projects. Build and maintain strong relationships with sources, photographers, editors and other stakeholders across Kenya and the wider region. Required Qualifications Candidates must have strong technical photography skills, including: Professional digital photography and camera skills. Digital image editing and processing. Accurate captioning and metadata management. Fast and reliable picture filing and transmission from the field. The ability to work with professional photography equipment and modern image-management and transmission systems. A strong understanding of photographic ethics, accuracy and Reuters' editorial standards. Preferred Qualifications Experience covering major breaking news, political, business, sporting or humanitarian events in East Africa or other complex reporting environments, with a demonstrated ability to deliver exclusive and agenda-setting visual journalism Experience working in an integrated newsroom environment, collaborating closely with text, video and digital teams to deliver coordinated, multi-format coverage for global audiences and clients. Strong knowledge of Kenya and the wider East Africa region, with an established network of contacts and a track record of identifying distinctive visual stories and enterprise projects. The successful candidate should have sound editorial judgement and be able to make quick decisions in the field about what to photograph, how to approach a story and which images best tell the story. They must be able to work independently while maintaining close communication with editors and colleagues. The role is based in Nairobi but will involve travel across Kenya, East Africa and, at times, other parts of the world. The successful candidate must be ready to travel at short notice and work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays when required by the news. From time to time, the candidate will also be expected to edit and manage pictures from photographers across the region. Strong picture-editing skills, attention to detail, sound editorial judgement, and excellent written and spoken English are therefore essential. Experience covering major international news events, elections, conflict, business, sports or other high-impact stories will be an advantage. Experience working in hostile or challenging environments will also be an advantage. At Reuters, we combine trusted journalism, technology and human expertise to help people make informed decisions. As part of the world's most trusted news organisation, you will help tell the stories that matter through powerful photography across Kenya, East Africa and beyond. The deadline for applications is September 18th, 2026. What’s in it For You? Benefits At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth: Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities. Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists. Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days. Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories. About Reuters Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers. About Thomson Reuters Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law.
